name: piercast
title: Piercast
description: Launch, monitor, and expose local apps managed by the Piercast daemon.
author: piercast

commands.name: search-apps
commands.title: Search Apps
commands.description: Fuzzy search registered Piercast apps and run actions.

commands.name: open-app
commands.title: Open App
commands.description: Open an app (auto-starts via POST /open if needed).

commands.name: start
commands.title: Start
commands.description: Start a Piercast app in development or production mode.

commands.name: stop
commands.title: Stop
commands.description: Gracefully stop a running Piercast app.

commands.name: restart
commands.title: Restart
commands.description: Restart a Piercast app with the same mode.

commands.name: expose
commands.title: Expose Via Tailscale
commands.description: Toggle Tailscale Serve, Funnel, or Off for an app.

commands.name: daemon-status
commands.title: Daemon Status
commands.description: Check whether piercastd is reachable on the control plane.

preferences.name: apiBaseUrl
preferences.title: API Base URL
preferences.description: Piercast control plane base URL (no trailing slash).

scripts.prepublishOnly: echo "Please run npm run build before publishing" && exit 1
